paragraphs.text: Eknet was an aven warrior from Amonkhet .

Eknet was a vizier of the Hekma guard, who was the first being to speak to the Gatewatch after they planeswalked to Amonkhet . Although Eknet started out accusing them of meddling with the Hekma and wearing strange clothes, Jace Beleren read his mind and convinced him to get Temmet to meet with them.
Eknet was part of the Dreadhorde on Ravnica , and was re-killed by Samut .
